summary: Non-blocking per-subagent-dispatch cost telemetry: host detection, host-stamped event logging, and the retrospective subagent-costs read-side pricer for /z-stats Phase 6.

entry_points.summary: Positive-marker host detection with claude default.
Z_HARNESS_HOST override or PPID-keyed host sentinel.
Builds role/type/model/chars plus optional provider token fields.
Emits the built payload via log-event.sh, which stamps host.
Computes input/output tokens and cost from a subagent_call.
Per-host, per-subagent_type aggregate from repo-wide metrics; retrospective observed-call cost surface distinct from pre-run forecasts.
Human-readable table formatter for the subagent-costs CLI subcommand.
Pins canonical logging sites and scans skills/ plus agents/ for unlogged implementer dispatches.
User-facing subagent-costs report; only section of the rewritten SKILL.md this concept still owns.

invariants: detect-host.sh never emits unknown or empty; claude is default.
log-event.sh stamps host; callers do not.
log-subagent.sh is non-fatal and always exits 0.
prompt_chars and response_chars stay separate; no collapsed est_tokens field.
provider token fields are optional and only included when non-empty.
subagent_call events land in repo-wide metrics at the resolved base.
Drift guard pins z-execute, reviewer, consultant-primary, consultant-secondary logging sites.
subagent-costs is retrospective over observed subagent_call events; it is exact only when provider_input_tokens/provider_output_tokens are present and otherwise labels chars/4 estimates.
Pre-run plan/execute forecasts from estimate-tokens.py are prospective and must not be presented as post-run subagent-costs accounting.
skills/z-stats/SKILL.md Phase 6 still shells out directly to scripts/estimate-tokens.py subagent-costs, unchanged by the 2026-07 rewrite that moved every other z-stats section onto scripts/stats.py.
gotchas: Host sentinel uses PPID, not $$ or a per-call process id.
Char-est cost rows are not equivalent to real-token rows.
Consultant orchestrator dispatches should not double-log because agents self-log.
Opt-out comment for implementer drift guard must be exactly # no-subagent-log: <reason>.
Do not compare /z-plan pre-run forecast totals to subagent-costs without noting that forecast execute components are wide static projections while subagent-costs reports observed calls only.

estimate-tokens.py entry-point line numbers drift fast: re-verify anchors on every refresh rather than trusting the prior doc (this refresh found a consistent -3 line shift on all three estimate-tokens.py anchors).

skills/z-stats/SKILL.md was rewritten 266->156 lines to absorb the former /z-where command as Phase 1 and delegate progress/walltime/tokens/coordination/halts/next-command to the new scripts/stats.py (not tracked by this concept); the subagent-costs entry point moved from the old 'Phase 3b' label to 'Phase 6' and will keep renumbering as scripts/stats.py's phase count changes, so pin future refreshes to the section header text, not the phase number alone.

No persona_attempt_outcome/persona_bound/persona_random_selected event kinds belong to this concept; the persona-rotation subsystem that emitted them has been excised and is tracked (where it still is) under separate scripts/watchdog concept docs.
